To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
venture capital investments standardize the governance and management of family firms, and that this standardization increases the valuation of these firms at the time they go public.
VC investments standardize family firms prior to initial public offerings (IPOs) by transforming their governance and top management, which yields better IPO firm valuation and performance post IPO.
VC backing transforms the governance of family firms by standardizing them and this transformation is associated with higher IPO firm valuations and post-IPO operating performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with

how VC backed family firms differ from non VC backed family firms prior to an IPO, how VC backing affects the management and governance of family firms, and the consequences of this for the valuation and performance of family firms.
the governance and management of family firms and the impact of VCs on them prior to IPOs.
the role of VC in transforming the governance of family firms and its consequences for IPO performance and operating performance post IPO.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
VCs transform the management and governance of family firms prior to IPOs by standardizing them and that such a standardization yields better performance outcomes.
VCs transform family firms by standardizing them, thereby increasing firm value.
VC backing standardizes the management and governance of family firms, which in turn increases their value.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
VC backing transforms family firms by reducing the power of the family and increasing the power of the professional manager.
VC backing standardizes family firms prior to their IPO, which is beneficial for their IPO performance and
VCs are able to standardize the governance and management of family firms, and that this is beneficial for family firms.
The main takeaway from our work is that
VC backing transforms the governance and management of family firms prior to their IPO.
VCs are effective at transforming family firms prior to IPOs.
VC backed family firms are more likely to be transformed into "standard" firms prior to IPO.
